representation: FP32 arguments, constants, intermediates, and result are uint binary32 encodings; arithmetic uses integer-bit primitives

primitive_dependencies.soft64: Not required: the pinned glibc_atanf CUDA operation graph is entirely FP32.
primitive_dependencies.state: soft_binary32.metalh and its arithmetic/NaN semantics are unverified and not centrally cleared. The declared interfaces exist, but this leaf must remain dependency-blocked until central review and verification.

bit_branches: Use ix=abs_bits(x); for |x| >= 2^25, return soft32_add(x,x) for NaNs, otherwise the pinned signed atanhi[3]+/-atanlo[3] expression.
For |x| < 2^-29, return original x bits unchanged.
For |x| < 0.4375, use id=-1 and retain input sign in x.
For the remaining finite domain, clear sign and use the exact source cut points 0x3f300000, 0x3f980000, and 0x401c0000 to select the four reductions.
Evaluate the ATAN polynomial with the exact source Horner ordering, then apply the source id reconstruction and original sign bit.
source_contract.rounding: Each source FADD, FSUB, FMUL, and FDIV maps to its corresponding soft32 operation boundary; no contraction or native floating arithmetic is introduced.
source_contract.nan_signed_zero_subnormal: Raw input/result bits are preserved in the tiny identity arm. Large NaNs use the source x+x path via soft32_add; signed infinities take the source signed pi/2 branch. Other special-value equivalence depends on review of the soft32 primitive contract.

noahmp_bare_flux: This leaf's soft32 primitive base must be centrally reviewed and verified.

The same CUDA translation unit calls glibc_logf and glibc_powf; their separate soft_gfk_log and soft_gfk_pow proposals remain unreviewed, and pow depends on the exp-owned soft_gfk_exp2_core_bits interface.
The full Noah-MP BARE_FLUX translation and its typed caller/layout still require separate implementation and central integration.
noahmp_bareflux_libm_probe: Requires glibc_logf, this glibc_atanf, and glibc_powf together; diagnostic probe only, no Metal entry is supplied.

constraints: No native float/double arithmetic, generic atan approximation, built-in atan, external math source, or duplicate family-local soft primitive is used.
No caller, registry, generated file, build file, state, inventory, or ledger is modified.
No kernel entrypoint or production consumer is added.
verification: MetalToolchain 27.1 compiled all four helpers together with the shared binary32/binary64 headers and executed the temporary kernel on Apple M2. Each of logf, expf, powf, and atanf matched the in-tree glibc 2.39 CPU transcription in woof/core/noahmp_libm.py exactly on 4,826 rows (zero bit mismatches each). Inputs covered special values, subnormals, thresholds and adjacent encodings, plus seeded random bit patterns/pairs. This is bounded evidence, not exhaustive certification; production consumption remains blocked by the shared primitive and consumer-level contracts.
